name: game_compat
description: Query a game's Linux compatibility from three sources: ProtonDB ratings and player reports, AreWeAntiCheatYet anti-cheat status, and the caniplayonlinux snapshot. Accepts a Steam App ID (number) or a game name. Content is parsed live from third-party sites; a missing source is not a negative verdict.

query.description: Steam App ID or game name.

max_reports.description: Number of ProtonDB reports, default 8, max 40. Use 0 for the verdict only, without reports.
